notes.disposition: Use tvēriens for a physical fretting configuration. Guarded fixes cover inconsistent chord-shape forma occurrences; scale-pattern forma is not blindly replaced.
Two bowed-string descriptions now specify zemo otro pirkstu rather than implying a whole-hand lower position.
Use masculine Latvian spiričuels with matching agreement.
Guarded grammatical repairs distinguish ordinal beat positions, quoted spoken counts, chord degrees and six eighth-note counts grouped into two large beats; source numerals remain unchanged.

Read all current source-defined movable-do contexts and retain the course’s seventh-degree ti. Do not substitute fixed-do si or confuse source B with German-system H. The LU publication attests ti within Latvian relative-solmization discussion but is not proof that every course syllable is the sole Latvian pedagogy standard. Native pedagogical preference/audio remains uncertified.

Banjo rolls, crosspicking, re-entrant tuning, tremolo and physical instructions were read in full context. Descriptive Latvian explanations carry meaning; no native-musician or actual-device/audio testing is claimed.
Source history, composers, dates and lyric underlay are immutable; this localization review is not a general historical fact-check or score/audio certification.
One proposed rewrite of the blues chord-degree sentence was withdrawn after recognizing the original locative construction as valid. It is not an active correction; see withdrawn-proposals.json.
